'''Chasuli''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] villager and member of the [[Myyydril]] tribe. She lived in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] along with the rest of her tribe, within the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Chasuli appears in the [[2005]] expansion pack for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' known as ''Rage of the Wookiees''. She was an incidental character and offered no quests to the player. ''Star Wars Galaxies'' was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
